defect_observations.observation: thm:p15-conc-weighted-learning eta=0 remark: the body (lines 340-342) says attainment is an additional requirement and the annex says 'An infimum at eta=0 need not be a minimum'. Under the entry's own hypotheses (w_h>0, sum of w_h at most 1) only finitely many h have w_h above any positive level, so b_h tends to infinity along any enumeration of an infinite class; the penalized scores R_n(h)+b_h then have a finite nonempty sublevel set below J+1, the infimum J is always attained, and the first index attaining J is a measurable exact selection. The caveat is vacuous and the annex sentence is false in this setting. Recorded as a correctness/clarity defect; per the audit rules it is not used as a coverage verdict.
